# Suggested Task for DSH
A resident plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that suggests actionable follow-up tasks at the end of
each completed turn—just like Claude Desktop's Suggested Tasks—and lets you start any single task or
**Start All** at once in isolated Git worktrees (`.agents/worktrees/<branch>`) as independent child
ll** at once in isolated Git worktrees (`.agents/worktrees/<branch>`) as independent child sessions.
English | 中文
## Features

- **Turn-end Suggested Tasks Card (`conversation.chat.turnTail`)**:
- After each completed turn, pro
poses 2–3 concrete follow-up tasks with a title, concise description, execution prompt, and target G

it branch slug.
- Click **Start** on an individual task or **Start all (N)** in the card header to l

aunch all unstarted tasks in parallel.
- Once started, each row displays live child-session status (

`Running` / `Ready`) and an **Open sub-session →** button.
- **Isolated Git Worktrees (`.agents/work

trees/...`)**:
- Starting a task forks the parent session at that completed turn's event boundary (i
nheriting the conversation context), creates a dedicated Git worktree and branch under `.agents/work
trees/<branch>`, switches the child session's working directory into that worktree, and dispatches t

he task prompt automatically.
- **Claude-style Sub-session Lineage & Sidebar Visuals**:
- **Left Sid
ebar Grouping & Indentation**: Child sessions are positioned directly beneath their parent session i
n the Workspace list, indented with a tree connector line, a sub-session branch icon (`sidebar.sessi
on.row.leading`), and a hover card (`sidebar.session.row.hover`) showing parent session and worktree

branch details.
- **Conversation Header Lineage (`conversation.session.header.actions`)**:
- On a c
hild session: displays a clickable **`↖ Parent: <Title>`** pill to jump back to the parent session a

nd a **`⎇ <branch>`** worktree chip.
- On a parent session: displays a **`↳ N sub-sessions`** dropdo

wn switcher with live running counts.
- **`/tasks` Slash Command**:
- `/tasks` or `/tasks generate [

turn]`: Generate or regenerate suggested tasks on demand.
- `/tasks start <turn> <taskId>`: Start a

single suggested task in an isolated worktree child session.
- `/tasks start-all [turn]`: Start all
unstarted tasks of a turn in parallel worktree child sessions.
## Requirements
- **DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.2`** (declared in `package.json` `engines.dsh`).
## Installation
### From GitHub (no build step)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh plugin add` forwards to pnpm inside the chosen profile, installs the package, and adds the bund
le to `dsh.profile.bundles` automatically because the package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`. The plugi
n is plain JavaScript with no `prepare` build script, so a Git install needs no extra pnpm build app
roval. Restart the profile for the plugin to load when HMR is disabled.
To pin the tagged release:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The Desktop application's `desktop` profile is reserved for the Electron app, so a standalone `dsh`
CLI rejects `--profile desktop`. Install there through **Settings → Plugins → Add** and paste the re
pository URL `https://github.com/littepointR/dsh-suggested-task`; the plugin applies without restart
ing the application.
### From a local checkout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The bundle patch inserts the `suggested-task` row, so the plugin survives restarts as a normal profi
patch inserts the `suggested-task` row, so the plugin survives restarts as a normal profile bundle.
## Configuration
Every field below is optional and can be overridden on the `suggested-task` row in the profile's `co
w is optional and can be overridden on the `suggested-task` row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | `false` skips the projection, turn listener, and `/tasks` command |
| `mode`
| `'fork'` | `'fork'` reuses the full conversation prefix; `'digest'` sends a compact JSON summary |

| `maxTasks` | `3` | Maximum suggested tasks per turn (`1..5`) |
| `maxTokens` | `1024` | Output bu

dget of the suggestion request |
| `temperature` | `0.3` | Sampling temperature |
| `timeoutMs` | `1

5000` | Hard bound on one suggestion request, in milliseconds |
| `maxForkChars` | `12000` | Convers

ation-window budget in `fork` mode |
| `maxInputChars` | `6000` | Excerpt bound in `digest` mode |
|

`fallback` | `true` | Retry with the compact digest when `fork` mode yields no tasks |
| `skipSubag

ents` | `true` | Subagent sessions get no task suggestions |
| `skipTaskSessions` | `true` | Child s

essions started from suggested tasks do not auto-suggest further tasks |
| `worktreePrefix` | `'task

/'` | Branch prefix for created Git worktrees (`task/add-unit-tests`) |
| `worktreeFallback` | `true

` | Start in the current directory when the session is not in a Git repository |
| `provider`, `mode
l` | unset | Explicit model route; defaults to the turn's own route |
